name: Conseil National de la Transition
notes: Transitional legislative body of Mali established following the August 2020 transition (expanded from 121 to 147 members by decree in 2022). Presided over by Colonel Malick Diaw.

name: Assemblée Nationale
notes: Former legislative chamber of Mali prior to its dissolution in August 2020; provided for as the lower chamber under the 2023 Constitution.
